lines.name: n1
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: In this town, everyone wants to make the NBA.

lines.name: n1b
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: And somehow, the best basketball player here, is a seventy-eight-year-old grandma.

lines.name: n2
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: Our mailman delivered packages like basketballs.

lines.name: n2b
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: And our baker thought he was Steph Curry.

lines.name: n3
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: But one day, our mayor announced that Rudy Gobert was coming to recruit someone for an NBA team.

lines.name: n4
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: So naturally, I started grinding.

lines.name: n4b
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: My best friend Ben invited me to a party, but I had bigger plans.

lines.name: h1
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: Huss!

lines.name: h2
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: Huss!

lines.name: h3
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: Huss!

lines.name: d4
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: While they're out partying, I'm out here grinding,

lines.name: btw4
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: by the way.

lines.name: n5
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: Meanwhile, Ben, the mailman, the baker, and even Grandma, were having the time of their lives.

lines.name: h4
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: Huss!

lines.name: h5
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: Huss!

lines.name: h6
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: Huss!

lines.name: n6
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: I trained so hard that I started dribbling while brushing my teeth, eating breakfast, and even using the bathroom.

lines.name: d6
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: While they're out partying, I'm out here getting better,

lines.name: btw6
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: by the way.

lines.name: n7
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: When tournament day arrived, the mailman got his ankles broken, the baker airballed a layup, and our mayor somehow fouled himself.

lines.name: n8
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: But Grandma was moving like she had a ninety-nine overall. She even dunked on the mayor without taking off her glasses.

lines.name: g8
lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: Too small!

lines.name: n9
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: Eventually, I made it to the finals against Grandma. Seven days of grinding, had all come down to this.

lines.name: q1
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: huss.

lines.name: q2
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: huss.

lines.name: q3
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: huss.

lines.name: n10
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: The game was tied, and with three seconds remaining, I finally got past Grandma. I thought my NBA career had officially begun.

lines.name: g10
lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: Not in my house!

lines.name: n11
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: But when Rudy announced who he was recruiting, he didn't choose me, or Grandma. He chose Ben.

lines.name: n11b
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: Apparently, Rudy wasn't recruiting a basketball player. He was recruiting a mascot.

lines.name: d12
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: Should've gone to the party,

lines.name: btw12
lines.speaker: alex
lines.text: by the way.
